faqData.q: What is your main area of expertise?
faqData.a: I'm focused on front-end web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) while learning Python and Java, with a growing interest in artificial intelligence and stock/crypto markets.

faqData.q: Are you available for research or freelance collaborations?
faqData.a: Yes! I'm early in my journey but always open to small freelance projects, collaborations, or learning opportunities where I can grow as a developer.

faqData.q: What is your typical tech stack for production?
faqData.a: Right now I mainly work with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for web projects, while learning Python and Java as I build toward AI engineering.

faqData.q: Do you have experience with enterprise or lab projects?
faqData.a: Not yet professionally — I'm still building my portfolio through personal projects like a to-do list app, a proposal website, and an animation showcase.

faqData.q: How can we start a partnership or project?
faqData.a: The best way is to use the contact form above or email me directly at sayeed3625525@gmail.com. I try to respond as soon as I can!
